Hi Evan — thanks for the RFI and the clear bandwidth/latency notes. We can absolutely get a short commercial + technical package over to you by EOD Monday; below is a crisp summary so you have it in writing before the call.

Quick commercial sketches (pilot-friendly):
- Option A (Rapid PoC): 30k trial credits + pay-as-you-go for extra usage. Good for fast evaluation; no commitment discounts.
- Option B (Committed Pilot): 3-month pilot: $40k committed spend with 20% onboarding credit applied (effectively $32k usable credits) + 10% lifecycle support credit. This gives priority on Dedicated throughput if you need bursts.

Technical recommendations (tradeoffs included):
- Quantization: suggest starting with dynamic INT8 (quant-aware calibration) for encoder-decoder checkpoints — typical CPU/GPU token cost reduction ~30–40% while preserving extractive QA F1 within ~1–2 pts. Avoid aggressive 4-bit configs for the initial pilot because reranking sensitivity can spike.
- Caching: KV prefix caching for repeated context fragments + short-term response caching for reranks. For your traffic pattern, enabling prefix caching on shorter, high-frequency templates should reduce token spend by ~18–25%.
- Batching: conservative batching in the hosted path (max batch latency budget 60 ms) — we can set autoscale burst to protect tail latency.

Next steps I’ll take now: draft a 1-page econ slate + 2-page tech note and a short SOW. Can you confirm the window you prefer for an ops call? Monday 11a PT or Tuesday 9a PT both work for us.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
